labyrint.title: Labyrinth Mariozo 🌀 Maze Obby
labyrint.description:
🌀 LABYRINTH MARIOZO — the maze obby that never ends!

Escape 500+ hand-built mazes that get trickier every level. Dodge traps, outrun the chasers, grab coins & gems, unlock cool wall themes, and beat your best time. Progress auto-saves — hop back in and keep climbing!

🎁 NEW: Daily reward — log in each day, clear a level, bank free coins & gems
🏆 Solo climb · race your friends · top the leaderboard
⚡ Compete for the FASTEST time AND the HIGHEST level
🧩 Fresh mazes and updates all the time

Perfect for fans of maze, parkour, escape and speedrun games — fun for all ages!

⭐ LIKE + FAVORITE to help the game grow!
Made by Mio · Donations to LicySpille 💜

crystal.title: Grow a Crystal 💎 (Cavern Idle)
crystal.description:
💎 Grow a Crystal 💎 — the COZY idle mining sim where seed-crystals GROW into rare gems even while you're offline! 🌙

Plant glowing seed-crystals, watch your cavern expand, and refract plain shards into LEGENDARY & MYTHIC gems. An AFK-friendly grow game — earn gems while you sleep! 😴✨

⛏️ FEATURES:
🌱 Plant & grow seed-crystals into rare tiers
💤 OFFLINE growth — come back to a fuller cavern
🔮 Weekly GEODE events for exclusive gems
🔁 Complete your Gem Codex
🕳️ Auto-expanding procedural crystal cavern
🎁 Redeem CODES for free boosts!

Love Grow a Garden, Fisch & cozy idle simulators? This is your next obsession. 💖

👍 LIKE + ⭐ FAVORITE to unlock more gems, codes & updates!

plus1.title: +1 Jump Every Step 🔼 Sky Temple Obby
plus1.description:
🔼 +1 JUMP EVERY STEP — the incremental Sky Temple obby!

Step on ANY tile to gain +1 Jump Power. The more you climb, the higher you jump — clear taller and taller procedural sky-temple ruins that never end!

⬆️ Every step = higher jumps
🏛️ Endless procedurally-generated tower
🔁 REBIRTH to bank a permanent jump multiplier (x2, x5, x10+)
🏆 Race the top-10 leaderboard
🎁 Free codes for instant jump boosts

Great for fans of obby, tower, parkour, jump and simulator games — fun for all ages!

⭐ LIKE + FAVORITE to help it grow!

anomaly.title: Anomaly: Night Shift at the Observatory 🔭
anomaly.description:
🔭 ANOMALY: NIGHT SHIFT AT THE OBSERVATORY 🔭 A spot-the-difference anomaly horror game!

You're the lone night caretaker of a looping observatory. Each pass, something might be WRONG. Spot an anomaly? TURN BACK (Q). Looks normal? ADVANCE (E). One wrong call resets your night to Day 1. 😱

No chase, no monster AI — just you, the hall, and your nerve.

🌙 24 hand-crafted anomalies (more every update)
📓 A Field Guide that fills in with every anomaly you catch
💡 Hint tokens for when you're not sure
🏆 Best-Day leaderboard — how deep can your streak go?
🎁 Free codes: WELCOME, OBSERVE, MIDNIGHT, ECLIPSE
🔊 Headphones on — the dark hides a lot

Can you reach Day 100 flawless?

❤️ LIKE + ⭐ FAVORITE to keep the lights on!
